rows.hypothesis: The Form 2275 / 2276A framing in the question is an inherited label: the CVN-79 funding actions at issue may not be Economy Act Orders at all, but program-office execution funding issued to SUPSHIP via a WBSE in Navy ERP, in which case no 2275 or 2276A was ever required and the correct supporting artifact is the WBSE funding communication.

rows.instruction: Request from the SUPSHIP Newport News commanding officer's administrative files the signed delegations of funds authority, the Comptroller qualification record, and the certifying-officer appointment and revocation letters in force during the reconciliation period, together with the DD 577 file. Keep this separate from any ERP query; a single file-room check kills or confirms it.
rows.target_document: Signed delegations of funds authority, certifying-officer appointments, DD 577 file
rows.target_office: SUPSHIP Newport News commanding officer and Comptroller
rows.period: Reconciliation period of record
rows.account: Not account-specific; command-wide funds authority
rows.hypothesis: The written delegations of funds authority and certifying-officer appointments exist as a separate command administrative file, not in ERP, so the request fails only because it was routed to the transaction system rather than to the commanding officer's records.

rows.instruction: Ask NAVSEA FM for the Navy ERP role and authorization matrix for the SUPSHIP Newport News fund center, specifically which roles permit display of purchase-requisition approval logs, document attachments and project-structure attachments, and request a read-only provisioning for the reconciliation team or a witnessed screen-share extraction of one named CVN-79 purchase requisition end to end as a feasibility test.
rows.target_document: ERP role-authorization matrix; one sampled requisition approval history with attachments
rows.target_office: NAVSEA FM and Navy ERP system authorization office
rows.period: Current, for a sample transaction from the reconciliation period
rows.account: SCN CVN-79 purchase requisitions and funding documents
rows.hypothesis: Access, not existence, is the binding constraint: the ERP approval histories and transaction attachments are retrievable only by role-provisioned users at the SUPSHIP fund center, and the requesting party lacks the display authorization for purchase requisitions, funding documents and project structures, consistent with the gap's own 'access_required' closability.

rows.instruction: Request from NAVSEA FM a custodianship statement identifying, for each CVN-79 transaction class in the reconciliation (commitments, obligations, disbursements), whether the documentary support resides at SUPSHIP Newport News, the carrier program office, or the paying office, and obtain the SUPSHIP O&M,N mission-allotment records separately so SCN construction actions are not demanded from the wrong custodian.
rows.target_document: Transaction-class custodianship statement; SUPSHIP O&M,N allotment records
rows.target_office: NAVSEA FM; PEO Carriers; SUPSHIP Newport News Comptroller
rows.period: Reconciliation period of record
rows.account: SCN and RDT&E (program office) versus O&M,N (SUPSHIP mission)
rows.hypothesis: SUPSHIP is not the custodian for the bulk of CVN-79 construction funding documentation because new-ship construction is budgeted and funded by the PEO from SCN and RDT&E, while SUPSHIP's own appropriated records are O&M,N mission funds; the transaction population the question presumes to sit at SUPSHIP largely sits with the program office and the contracting/payment offices.

rows.instruction: Request from the SUPSHIP Newport News Comptroller the CVN-79 accounting-adjustment and reclassification log for the reconciliation period, including any purpose-correction entries and their authorizing memoranda, plus the OWLD and appropriation-expiration determination for the CVN-79 SCN line from the carrier program office, and the disbursement-to-obligation and accounts-payable matching reports. Compare the adjusted transactions against the set for which no original work request can be produced.
rows.target_document: Adjustment/reclassification log with authorizing memoranda; OWLD determination; disbursement-to-obligation matching reports
rows.target_system: Navy ERP (and STARS-HCM for pre-conversion adjustments)
rows.target_office: SUPSHIP Newport News Comptroller; PEO Carriers for OWLD determination
rows.period: Reconciliation period through appropriation expiration per OWLD
rows.account: SCN CVN-79, including outfitting and post-delivery projects
rows.hypothesis: Part of the population cannot be produced because the supporting records were never generated in the form requested: records for actions whose purpose was later corrected, or whose appropriation has passed its OWLD-governed expiration, may exist only as adjusting entries without the original work request or approval attachment, which is also where a wrong-purpose charge would surface.

rows.instruction: query: Which CVN-79-related reimbursable work orders, project orders and RCP-funded tasks exist, and which performing activity owns the accounting record and obligation-recording event for each?
rows.target_system: SUPSHIP Comptroller and PEO Aircraft Carriers (reimbursable order register / Navy ERP)
rows.hypothesis: floor: the gap's own type and executor

rows.instruction: Pull SUPSHIP Newport News Comptroller's annual reimbursable work order register (acceptance log) for FY11 through the CVN-79 delivery year and filter for any order citing CVN-79 or its hull/program code; a nil or PSA-only return kills the premise in one query. Source of the asserted label: the gap question's own NAMED EXECUTOR line.
rows.target_document: SUPSHIP Newport News reimbursable work order register / acceptance file
rows.target_office: SUPSHIP Newport News Comptroller
rows.period: FY11 through CVN-79 delivery FY
rows.account: Reimbursable work orders accepted by SUPSHIP NN (all customers)
rows.hypothesis: No CVN-79 reimbursable or project-order population can be enumerated because the gap's premise — that SUPSHIP Newport News holds reimbursable work orders tied to CVN-79 — is an inherited label from the question/NAMED EXECUTOR field rather than a tested fact; SUPSHIP may accept reimbursable orders only for work outside its appropriated mission, and new-construction CVN-79 work is PEO-funded SCN/RDT&E mission work, so the correct population may be empty or limited to non-mission items (e.g., out-of-build-yard PSA support).

rows.instruction: Request from PEO Aircraft Carriers (PMS 379) the CVN-79 WBSE funding-authorization communications to SUPSHIP NN (WBSE, authorized purpose, amount) and compare that list against the SUPSHIP reimbursable acceptance register for the same quarters; items present as WBSE funding and absent from the register are not reimbursable work.
rows.target_document: PEO Carriers WBSE funding authorization / allocation letters to SUPSHIP
rows.target_office: PEO Aircraft Carriers (program office)
rows.period: Quarterly allocations, FY11 onward
rows.account: CVN-79 program WBSE execution funding to SUPSHIP fund center
rows.hypothesis: The CVN-79 work the gap treats as reimbursable is in fact funded by the carrier program office directly to SUPSHIP through a WBSE in its own budget structure (execution funding), not through a reimbursable or project order at all, so there is no separate performing-activity accounting record to find.

rows.instruction: Query Navy ERP for all accepted project orders and Economy Act orders citing the CVN-79 program/WBS where the performing activity code is not SUPSHIP NN, for FY11 forward, and obtain each named performing activity's acceptance documentation showing the obligation date and owning accounting office.
rows.target_document: Accepted project order / Economy Act order files with acceptance dates and amendments
rows.target_office: PEO Aircraft Carriers reimbursable order register; receiving performing activities' comptrollers
rows.period: FY11 forward
rows.account: Project orders and Economy Act orders citing CVN-79
rows.hypothesis: Part of the population is Economy Act and project orders accepted by activities other than SUPSHIP (other SUPSHIPs, NSWC/NUWC warfare centers, naval shipyards), so the accounting record and the obligation-recording event sit with those performing activities and are structurally absent from SUPSHIP's ledger — explaining omission rather than any missing dollars.

rows.instruction: Retrieve the in-house/contract-out projections supporting each CVN-79-related reimbursable order accepted by SUPSHIP NN, and cross-check against the NAVSEA RCP task listing for the same tasks and periods; a task appearing in the RCP listing kills its reimbursable classification.
rows.target_document: Reimbursable order in-house work projection worksheets; NAVSEA RCP task authorization listing
rows.target_office: NAVSEA Comptroller (RCP) and SUPSHIP NN Comptroller
rows.period: Execution years FY11 forward
rows.account: RCP-funded task listing vs. reimbursable order in-house projections
rows.hypothesis: Some tasks now labeled reimbursable fail the in-house share test (projection that a majority of funds support in-house work) and should have been RCP-funded; the records therefore exist under an RCP account rather than as reimbursable orders, and the gap is a funding-vehicle mislabel.

rows.instruction: Run the same CVN-79 reimbursable/project-order query against STARS-HCM and STARS-FL at SUPSHIP NN for FY10-and-earlier funding plus residual FY11 obligations, and specifically for ship-construction-contract transactions that transitioned to ERP late; reconcile the two populations by order number.
rows.target_document: STARS-HCM/STARS-FL general ledger and obligation detail for CVN-79 orders
rows.target_office: SUPSHIP Newport News Comptroller; NAVSEA Comptroller
rows.period: FY10 and earlier, plus residual FY11
rows.account: Legacy general-fund reimbursable/project-order balances citing CVN-79
rows.hypothesis: Pre-FY11 CVN-79-related orders and some FY11 obligations were never converted to Navy ERP and remain in STARS-HCM/STARS-FL, so an ERP-only pull of the reimbursable register returns an incomplete population — the records exist but in the legacy system of record.

rows.instruction: For each CVN-79 order in the register, pull the paired obligation-event records (MIPR issuance/contract award date vs. reimbursable acceptance date) and the SUPSHIP Comptroller's disbursement-to-obligation/accounts-payable match, plus any funding increases lacking a signed amendment; matched duplicate task descriptions across the two event types confirm double counting.
rows.target_document: Obligation event detail and amendment file per order; Comptroller disbursement match reports
rows.target_office: SUPSHIP Newport News Comptroller
rows.period: FY11 forward, by quarter
rows.account: CVN-79 obligation events: direct-cite MIPR awards vs. reimbursable acceptances
rows.hypothesis: Double counting, not omission, drives the gap: the same CVN-79 task is recorded once as a direct-cite MIPR obligation at contract award and again as a reimbursable-order obligation at acceptance, or an order was increased without the required written amendment, producing a reconciliation artifact rather than unexplained work.
